objective: Run the native local validation loop for the new private C-Shop worker adapter against the pinned standalone C-Shop runtime. The adapter implementation and dependency-free contract suite are already complete. Confirm the Rust build/runtime/GPU path, confirm the pinned-source findings under the real server, run the real graphics smoke export, fix only concrete adapter defects if found, rerun validation, and return one evidence-backed PASS/FAIL receipt. Do not merge or deploy.

chatgpt_validation_already_completed.note: Node 22 passing is incidental compatibility only; package support remains Node >=24.
chatgpt_validation_already_completed.reason_hermes_is_still_required: Native C-Shop compilation and real MCP rendering cannot be completed in the ChatGPT runner because Rust and container runtimes are absent.

pinned_source_findings.finding: C-Shop session_of() uses the supplied sane Mcp-Session-Id, otherwise generates a fresh random session id for that request. Omitted-session multi-call workflows therefore do not retain one document across calls.
pinned_source_findings.adapter_boundary: CShopClient always supplies one explicit session id for every RPC call.

pinned_source_findings.finding: GET / and GET /health do not pass through the bearer-token guard. /health reports workspace and active session metadata; / also reports workspace/auth/tool information.
pinned_source_findings.adapter_boundary: Loopback is enforced by default. Non-loopback client endpoints require explicit allowRemote=true plus a bearer token.

pinned_source_findings.finding: Style lookup searches the workspace/base and style directories beside the executable, while served Runner instances otherwise carry a Sandbox for script-named file paths.
pinned_source_findings.adapter_boundary: The commerce job rejects unknown fields including script and emits no style command. Do not broaden this during validation.

security_boundary: Keep C-Shop loopback-only for this validation. Do not expose port 7333 publicly.
Do not touch the protected production branch feat/hermes-commerce-control-plane.
Do not modify Render, seller payment configuration, ledgers, wallets, signing state, or live-value settings.
Do not merge this feature branch.
The commerce adapter rejects arbitrary/unknown raw job fields including script and must not emit C-Shop style commands in this first slice.
Use an isolated disposable C-Shop workspace for runtime tests.

execution.name: Synchronize the implementation branch
execution.pass: Working tree is clean and HEAD is the remote feature branch head.

execution.name: Run the complete adapter unit suite
execution.pass: All 4 adapter tests pass under Node 24 or newer. If Node is older, use the existing project-supported Node 24 environment rather than weakening the package requirement.

execution.name: Prepare the pinned standalone C-Shop checkout
commands: if [ ! -d c-shop/.git ]; then git clone https://github.com/stubbb/c-shop.git c-shop; fi
execution.pass: The checkout is exactly pinned. Record the Rust/Cargo versions. If the installed Rust is too old, use rustup/current stable locally; do not edit C-Shop just to accommodate an obsolete compiler.

execution.name: Build and run upstream tests
execution.pass: Workspace tests and release build pass. If an environment-specific GPU/window test cannot run, preserve the exact command/error and distinguish an environment limitation from a code failure. Do not enter an architecture/replanning loop.

execution.name: Runtime-confirm the three pinned-source findings
instructions: Do not perform a fresh architecture investigation. Confirm the already-recorded static findings against the actual pinned server with bounded disposable tests.
Confirm explicit Mcp-Session-Id calls retain one document across calls and omitted-header calls do not retain one document across separate requests.
GET / and GET /health while loopback-bound and capture the unauthenticated workspace/session metadata actually returned.

Use a disposable style canary only if needed to confirm the recorded style filesystem surface. Do not enable style in the adapter and do not edit upstream unless this bounded confirmation reveals a blocker to the existing no-style workflow.
execution.pass: Runtime evidence matches or precisely corrects each recorded finding. Any correction must identify the exact source/runtime discrepancy.

execution.name: Run a real end-to-end graphics smoke job
commands: for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7333/health >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
execution.pass: The adapter completes a real MCP job, the report contains zero failed C-Shop steps, a preview is returned, and the full-size exported image exists and is non-empty.

execution.name: Fix only concrete adapter failures and rerun everything
instructions: If steps 2 or 6 expose an adapter defect, fix the complete coherent defect on feat/cshop-worker-adapter, then rerun the full adapter unit suite and the live smoke job.
If upstream C-Shop itself requires a code change, do not copy its source into agent-commerce-hub. Record the exact blocker and proposed separate-fork change instead.
Do not broaden scope into a public graphics API, product publication, Render deployment, or generalized graphics framework.
execution.pass: No known adapter failure remains after the final full validation.

execution.name: Return one closure receipt
instructions: Include: hub HEAD, C-Shop SHA, Node/Rust/Cargo versions, adapter test totals, cargo test totals, build result, runtime confirmation of the three source findings, smoke report, output file size/type, any patches made, and a final CSHOP_WORKER_RUNTIME_VALIDATION=PASS or FAIL.
If code was changed, commit it together with the result and push feat/cshop-worker-adapter. Do not merge.
execution.pass: The result is self-contained enough for ChatGPT to fix a failure or close the validation without another discovery pass.

fallback: If native C-Shop cannot start solely because the local environment lacks the graphics/Vulkan runtime, preserve the exact native failure and make one bounded attempt using C-Shop's own pinned Docker setup if Docker is already available. Do not install a large new virtualization stack solely for this validation. If neither path is available, return FAIL_ENVIRONMENT with the exact blocker rather than looping.
stop_condition: Adapter implementation complete + 4/4 adapter tests pass + pinned C-Shop build/relevant tests pass (or explicitly bounded environment-only exclusions) + real MCP smoke export passes + three pinned-source findings are runtime-confirmed + no known adapter blocker = DONE.
